title: lycianthes banahaensis
intro: Lycianthes banahaensis, commonly known as the Banahao flower, is a species of flowering plant in the nightshade family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and rheumatism, due to its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Lycianthes banahaensis include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
